tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. bg-background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on background, card, popover, muted, secondary, accent and every -soft ground. text-foreground.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, link editor panels, stat tiles, tables. bg-card.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. text-card-foreground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, select lists, dialogs. bg-popover.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Coral. The one primary action per view and checked switches. Never as text, and never as the only edge of a control on light grounds (2.8:1 on white). bg-primary.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Violet text and icons on primary, and the edge of a checked switch. Never white on coral. text-primary-foreground.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, condition chips, rule numbers, role badges. bg-secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Table header rows, tab tracks, empty states, record wells. Keep inputs off muted grounds (input is 2.9:1 there). bg-muted.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on background, card, popover and muted. text-muted-foreground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, menu items, ghost and outline button hover. bg-accent.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Revoke API key, remove user, delete domain, and error text on background, card, popover and destructive-soft. Filled in light; in dark use destructive-soft with a destructive edge so it never reads as coral. bg-destructive, text-destructive.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table rows, dividers. Decorative only. border-border.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, switches, outline buttons and the active tab; 3:1 on background and card. border-input.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline 2px outside the control; 3:1 or more on every surface. outline-ring.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Clicks. First chart series. Deeper than primary so it holds 3:1 on card and background.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Unique visitors. Second series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third breakdown series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth breakdown series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth breakdown series; fold further series into Other.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar ground. bg-sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar text on sidebar and sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: The current-item marker in the sidebar. Violet, so only the logo is a coral tile.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and current sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text of the hovered and current sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and group dividers.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Text on a filled destructive (light theme buttons and badges).

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Ground of destructive alerts, and of destructive buttons and badges in dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Active links. Text and icons on background, card and success-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Ground of success badges; of success alerts in light.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Pending verification, approaching limits. Text and icons on background, card and warning-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Ground of warning badges; of warning alerts in light.

tokens.name: brand-coral
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Logo tile and marketing fields. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: flitz addition. Logo ink and violet on coral. Same in both themes; not a text colour on dark grounds.

families.heading: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Bricolage Grotesque", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Figtree Variable", Figtree, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Heading
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, bundled with Fontsource in the app. Optical size follows font size. Tailwind font-heading, which shadcn CardTitle uses.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Short URLs that know where to go.
styles.usage: Website hero only; 48px/52px below 640px. font-heading text-display max-sm:text-5xl max-sm:leading-13.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One page title per view. font-heading text-title.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Headline numbers in stat tiles. font-heading text-stat tabular-nums.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card, chart, section and dialog headings. font-heading text-heading.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree, bundled with Fontsource in the app. Tabular figures available.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Self-host it, connect your AI agent, and count clicks without storing IP addresses.
styles.usage: Marketing paragraphs and empty-state intros. text-lead.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: iPhones go to the App Store, Android phones to Google Play, everyone else to your website.
styles.usage: The UI default: tables, forms, descriptions. text-body (same size as text-sm).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Where visitors go when no redirect rule matches.
styles.usage: Hints and errors; with font-medium also table headers, chips, stat labels and small buttons. text-small.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, metadata, chart axes and legends. text-caption.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: DM Mono, bundled with Fontsource in the app.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Short URLs, slugs, targets, API keys, DNS records; always translate="no". font-mono text-mono.

spacing.note: 4px base, identical to the Tailwind scale: space-N is p-N, gap-N, m-N.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between landing page sections.

radius.note: Current shadcn derivation: radius × 0.6 / 0.8 / 1 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 / 2.6. Controls that act are pills (radius-full); fields and containers use the scale.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: shadcn --radius (0.75rem). Every step below is derived from it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: radius × 0.6. Record wells inside alerts, legend keys. rounded-sm.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: radius × 0.8. Inputs, selects, input groups. rounded-md.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: radius × 1. Cards, alerts, tables, redirect rule rows. rounded-lg.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: radius × 1.4. Dialogs and sheets. rounded-xl.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: radius × 1.8. Marketing panels on the website. rounded-2xl.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: radius × 2.2. rounded-3xl.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: radius × 2.6. rounded-4xl.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The speed-line pill from the mark: buttons, badges, chips, tabs, the short URL chip, switches. rounded-full.

shadow.note: Named elevation-* so they never collide with Tailwind's --shadow-* namespace; globals.css maps them to shadow-xs/sm/lg. Borders do most of the separating.

tokens.name: elevation-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at rest. Mapped to shadow-xs.

tokens.name: elevation-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that need lift from a tinted ground. Mapped to shadow-sm.

tokens.name: elevation-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts. Mapped to shadow-lg.

timing.note: One curve, two durations. Reduced motion keeps colour and opacity fades and drops movement.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every hover, press, toggle, tab and popover entrance. Also Tailwind's default transition curve.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggle, tab change. Tailwind's default transition duration.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs.
